subject: function:AudioStreamPlay
value: AudioStreamPlay's four ErrorPrintf format strings already equal retail. The R65 base-datum candidate was not a wrong source string: target uses sAudioTimeoutMsg as a shared address base and adds 220, 248, 220 and 284 bytes at the consuming instructions. The raw compiler uses its local first stream literal plus 0, 28, 0 and 64. Resolving each consumer yields the same bad-file, no-buffer-memory, bad-file and stream-error strings. Replacing source messages with Audio Play Timeout would introduce a bug. This is a narrow candidate-screen calibration, not whole-function equality or a generic PPC equivalence proof.
